verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no update path. There is no explicit update command, no auto-update mechanism, and no guidance on refreshing skill files written by `ultrametric init`. The CLI install doc only shows a version-pinned `npm install -g ultrametric@0.4.1`, and `doctor` reports the CLI version without describing how to upgrade. The hosted remote MCP endpoint may stay current server-side, but nothing in the evidence documents that as an update mechanism.
